description: The Cleveland Fed's daily nowcast of inflation not yet published: its estimate of CPI, core CPI, PCE and core PCE for the coming months and the quarter, on the month, on a year and annualized, beside the last month published. month gives one month's nowcast day by day and its figure once out; record sets the last nowcast before each release against the published figure, with the average miss. A plain summary first. No key.

measure.description: cpi, core_cpi, pce or core_pce; default all four.

month.description: A target month (YYYY-MM): its nowcast day by day, and the published figure once out.

months.description: record: published months shown, latest last; default 12.

record.description: The nowcast's record: its last nowcast before each release against the published figure, month by month.

name: inflation_nowcast

outputSchema.description: months and quarters are tables of a period and measure with the latest nowcast and, once published, the figure and its day, in percent. With month, rows are days with each measure's nowcast; with record, rows are published months with the last nowcast, the figure and the miss.

title: Inflation nowcast (Cleveland Fed)
